title: Recursive Integrity Toolkit Configuration
description: Phase 2 structural contract for explicit local configuration. Cross-field data validation remains in the Phase 2 validation layer.

config_version.description: Version of the configuration document format.

inputs.description: Explicit local input-role declarations. Detailed cardinality and filesystem validation are performed by the Phase 2 input layer.

representation.description: Declared state representation. Presence does not execute representation analysis in Phase 2.

state_mapping.description: Explicit state mapping declaration only. Phase 2 does not execute analytical state assignment.

version_order.description: Explicit dataset versions in user-declared chronological order.

strict_mode.description: Promote only explicitly configured warnings in later validation steps.

lineage.description: Explicit lineage execution request for audit or example. Input-only validate rejects true.

output.description: Reserved local output settings. Phase 2 does not generate analytical reports.

simulation.description: Explicit experimental scenario declaration. Presence never executes a simulation in Phase 2.
